get.description: Returns the sales-channel-resolved subset of the system configuration that headless frontends (e.g. Composable Frontends) need to render the shop consistently with the administration settings. Only UI- and validation-relevant, non-sensitive values are exposed.

200.description: Returns the shop settings of the current sales channel.

metaAuthor.description: Name displayed as the author of the website in search results or on social media (meta author tag)

metaRobots.description: Default content of the robots meta tag, can be overridden per CMS page

familyFriendly.description: Whether the "isFamilyFriendly" meta tag for search engines is set

showRevocationButton.description: Whether the "Revoke a contract" link is shown in the page footer

contactForm.description: Form field settings (core.basicInformation), used by the contact form and the online revocation request form

firstNameFieldRequired.description: Whether the first name field has to be filled in to submit the form

lastNameFieldRequired.description: Whether the last name field has to be filled in to submit the form

phoneNumberFieldRequired.description: Whether the phone number field has to be filled in to submit the form

loginRegistration.description: Login, registration and address form settings (core.loginRegistration)

passwordMinLength.description: Minimum password length on customer sign-up, also applies to password change and recovery

createCustomerAccountDefault.description: Whether the account creation option is pre-selected in the checkout registration form. If inactive, the customer purchases as a guest by default

showSalutation.description: Whether the salutation field is shown in registration and address forms

showTitleField.description: Whether the title field is shown in registration and address forms

requireEmailConfirmation.description: Whether the email address has to be entered twice to avoid input errors

requirePasswordConfirmation.description: Whether the password has to be entered twice to avoid input errors

doubleOptInRegistration.description: Whether double opt-in is required for new customer registrations. The account is inactive until the emailed confirmation link is opened

doubleOptInGuestOrder.description: Whether double opt-in is required for guest orders

showPhoneNumberField.description: Whether the phone number field is shown in registration and address forms

phoneNumberFieldRequired.description: Whether the phone number field is required

showBirthdayField.description: Whether the birthday field is shown in the registration form

birthdayFieldRequired.description: Whether the birthday field is required

showAccountTypeSelection.description: Whether the selection between a private and a commercial (company) account is shown

showNameFieldsForCompanyAccounts.description: Whether the first and last name fields are shown for a commercial (company) account

nameFieldsRequiredForCompanyAccounts.description: Whether the first and last name fields are required for a commercial (company) account. A hidden field is never required.

showAdditionalAddressField1.description: Whether the additional address line 1 is shown in address forms

additionalAddressField1Required.description: Whether the additional address line 1 is required

showAdditionalAddressField2.description: Whether the additional address line 2 is shown in address forms

additionalAddressField2Required.description: Whether the additional address line 2 is required

addressInputFieldArrangement.description: Arrangement of the address fields City, ZIP and State. Empty string when not configured, which equals the default arrangement (city-zip-state)

allowCustomerDeletion.description: Whether customers may delete their own account from the account profile page

requireDataProtectionCheckbox.description: Whether the privacy policy has to be acknowledged via a checkbox on registration and other forms

maxQuantity.description: Maximum selectable quantity per line item

lineItemAddLimit.description: Maximum number of products that can be added to the cart per minute through the API

showDeliveryTime.description: Whether the delivery time is shown in the cart

showSubtotal.description: Whether the subtotal column is shown in the cart

columnTaxInsteadUnitPrice.description: Whether the checkout confirm page shows a tax column instead of the unit price

showCustomerComment.description: Whether the customer comment field is shown on the checkout confirm page

showTosCheckbox.description: Whether customers are required to agree to the terms and conditions via a checkbox in the checkout

openOffcanvasAfterAddToCart.description: Whether the offcanvas cart should open automatically after adding a product. If disabled, only a success message is supposed to be shown

wishlistEnabled.description: Whether the wishlist feature is enabled

logoutGuestAfterCheckout.description: Whether guest customers are automatically logged out after order completion

listing.description: Product listing, search and review settings (core.listing)

productsPerPage.description: Number of products displayed per page in product listings and search results

allowBuyInListing.description: Whether buy buttons are displayed beneath every product in listings. If disabled, only detail buttons are supposed to be shown

reviewsPerPage.description: Number of reviews displayed per page on a product page

disableEmptyFilterOptions.description: Whether filter options without results are disabled instead of hidden

markAsNew.description: Number of days after the release date during which a product is marked as new

hideCloseoutProductsWhenOutOfStock.description: Whether clearance sale products are hidden from listings as soon as their stock depletes to 0

showVariantOptionInSearchSuggestionResul.description: Whether variant options are displayed underneath the product name in search suggestion results

findBestVariant.description: Whether the best matching variant is previewed in search results and filtered listings

autoplayVideoInListing.description: Whether videos configured as product media covers are played automatically in listings

beforeListPriceSnippetKey.description: Translation snippet key whose content is displayed before every list price. Empty string when nothing should be displayed

afterListPriceSnippetKey.description: Translation snippet key whose content is displayed after every list price. Empty string when nothing should be displayed

doubleOptIn.description: Whether double opt-in is required for newsletter subscriptions

doubleOptInRegistered.description: Whether double opt-in is also required for newsletter subscriptions of registered customers

401.description: The `sw-access-key` header is missing or invalid.
